places.name: RozMarine – Tapas și Vin
places.evidence: Owner-chef Octavian Băloi cooks in the open kitchen daily; local-press interviews (TomisTV, Bookingham) describe it as his personal project grown from 'Bucătărie la Vedere'

places.name: Tara's GastroPub
places.evidence: AmFostAcolo review: the owner is 'the artisan of the dishes' and frequently comes out of the kitchen to interact with guests

places.name: Bacaro Port
places.evidence: Owner Matei (third-generation fisherman family) described in press as 'involved body and soul' in daily operations; father still active in the business

places.name: La Ana și Ion
places.evidence: Family-run Romanian restaurant whose owners' family story is printed in the menu (Ziua de Constanța feature); positioned as a personal/family project

places.name: Bosfor Turkish Restaurant
places.evidence: AmFostAcolo review notes the (Turkish) owner personally serving tables; long-standing independent family business

places.name: Haute Cup
places.evidence: Founded and run by Andrei Duda & Alexandru Wagner as a personal passion project (ZF.ro founder interview); hands-on founders importing/roasting their own coffee
